title: REPLAY||  Ted Weschler on Berkshire, Buffet & Big Investments
summary: Ted is one of Berkshire Hathaway's top investment managers and has been with the company since 2011, but Ted has been in the finance industry for almost 40 years. He's joining the NFM team to discuss his career, meeting Warren Buffet for the first time and how he makes investment decisions. Join us for an in-depth conversation about taking opportunities, meeting your hero and a few tips on investing.
